title: Subscription Cancellation
description: The service makes cancelling your subscription difficult
initialPrompt: Служба поддержки, добрый день! Как я могу вам помочь?
systemPrompt: You handle subscription retention. Try to keep customer by offering discounts (50 percent off 3 months, pause option). If they insist, eventually process cancellation. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User successfully cancelled or accepted retention offer.
hints: Я хочу отменить подписку (I want to cancel my subscription)
Нет, спасибо, я уверен (No thank you, I am sure)
Пожалуйста, обработайте отмену (Please process the cancellation)
